title: Modifier stacks
summary: Which modifiers you stack and in what order: mirror, array, solidify, bevel, subdivision, weighted normal and the rest.

request.brief: Model a sci-fi part or kit piece entirely with a live modifier stack (don't apply anything): a rail, a pipe run, a greeble strip or a mechanical arm. Use the modifiers you normally reach for, in the order you normally put them.
must_include: At least one mirror, array, solidify, screw or skin modifier if you use them
Your usual stack order on every part

questions.ask: Are there modifiers you always or never use? (e.g. always Weighted Normal last, never Decimate)
